```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
source("R/counts.R")
DATA_DIR <- "../docs/global_analysis_data"
# Small convenience: build a coverage row from a cache filename.
row_of <- function(source, rds, script, note = NULL, sub = NULL,
                    col_iso = "iso3", extras = NULL) {
  n <- iso3_count(rds, col = col_iso, data_dir = DATA_DIR)
  yr <- if (rds == "nasa_giss.rds") {
    # NASA has global rather than iso3 rows; peek global$year range
    g <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, rds))$global, error=function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(g) && "year" %in% names(g))
      sprintf("%d–%d", min(g$year), max(g$year)) else "?–?"
  } else if (rds == "esmap_mtf.rds") {
    "2018–2020 (manifest)"
  } else year_range(rds, sub = sub, data_dir = DATA_DIR)
  n_str <- if (is.na(n)) "—" else format(n, big.mark=",")
  extras_str <- if (is.null(extras)) "" else paste0(" × ", extras)
  sprintf("| **%s** | %s countries × %s%s | `%s` |",
          source, n_str, yr, extras_str, script)
}
# For the WHO air pull, WHO PM2.5 vs Clean-fuel share a single RDS with two
# sub-frames; pull each by name
who_iso <- function(sub) {
  d <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "who_air.rds"))[[sub]],
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d) || !"iso3" %in% names(d)) return(NA_integer_)
  length(unique(d$iso3))
}
who_years <- function(sub) {
  d <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "who_air.rds"))[[sub]],
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d) || !"year" %in% names(d)) return("?–?")
  sprintf("%d–%d", min(d$year, na.rm=TRUE), max(d$year, na.rm=TRUE))
}
n_wb_wdi_ind <- length(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "wb_wdi_1960.rds")))
n_ember_fuels <- length(unique(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "ember_by_fuel.rds"))$fuel))
n_wgi_dims <- length(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "wgi_tidy.rds"))$long)
n_hbs_quintiles <- 5L   # QU1..QU5 fixed in Eurostat schema
n_owid_energy_cols <- ncol(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "owid_energy.rds")))
esmap <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "esmap_mtf.rds")),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
n_esmap_covered <- if (!is.null(esmap) && !is.null(esmap$covered_iso3))
  length(esmap$covered_iso3) else NA_integer_
```

# Data provenance

Every number on this site is traceable back to a specific data source,
a specific script that pulls it, and a specific cache file. Every pull
is reproducible with the code at [github.com/ericscheier/emburdensynth](https://github.com/ericscheier/emburdensynth).

The coverage table below is **built at render time from the cache
files themselves** — the numbers you see are the current counts in
each RDS, not frozen literals from when this page was first written.

| Source | Coverage | Retrieval script |
|---|---|---|
`r row_of("WB WDI (indicators)", "wb_wdi_1960.rds", "build_wb_wdi_1960.R", extras = sprintf("%d indicators", n_wb_wdi_ind), sub = "urban_pop_pct")`
`r row_of("WB Gini historical", "temporal_deep_history.rds", "build_temporal_deep_history.R", sub = "gini")`
| **WB GCD 2010** | 92 countries × 11 sectors | (pre-pipeline) |
`r row_of("WB Clean-fuel access", "who_air.rds", "build_who_air_pollution.R", sub = "clean")` <!-- sub-frame -->
`r row_of("WGI (governance)", "wgi_tidy.rds", "fix_wgi_v2.R", extras = sprintf("%d dimensions", n_wgi_dims), sub = "wide", col_iso = "code")`
`r row_of("Eurostat HBS", "eurostat_quintile_spread.rds", "build_eurostat_quintile_spread.R", extras = sprintf("%d quintiles", n_hbs_quintiles))`
| **Eurostat energy poverty** | ~30 countries × 2010–2023 | (cached prior) |
`r row_of("Ember Electricity Data", "ember_by_fuel.rds", "build_ember_by_fuel.R", extras = sprintf("%d fuel categories", n_ember_fuels))`
`r row_of("OWID Energy", "owid_energy.rds", "build_owid_energy.R", extras = sprintf("%d variables", n_owid_energy_cols))`
`r row_of("OWID CO2", "owid_co2.rds", "build_owid_co2.R", extras = "per-capita + cumulative + by-fuel")`
`r row_of("EIA International", "eia_international.rds", "build_eia_international.R", sub = "elec_total_bkwh")`
`r row_of("WHO PM2.5", "who_air.rds", "build_who_air_pollution.R", sub = "pm25")`
`r row_of("FAOSTAT food security", "fao_food.rds", "build_fao_food_security.R")`
`r row_of("UNDP HDI", "undp_hdi.rds", "build_undp_hdi.R", sub = "hdi")`
| **NASA GISTEMP v4** | 1880–2025 global + zonal | `build_nasa_giss.R` |
| **WorldPop 1 km rasters** | `r cell_country_count()` countries × 2020 | (pre-pipeline) |
| **GADM v4.1 boundaries** | 255 countries × admin-0 | (via `emburdengeo`) |
| **ESMAP Multi-Tier Framework** | `r if (is.na(n_esmap_covered)) "?" else n_esmap_covered` countries in manifest (surveys click-through XLSX) | `build_esmap_mtf_tiers.R` |
| **NREL ResStock + RECS + EULP** | US only, adapted globally | `emburdendata::download_*` |
| **CDC HHI + WONDER + PLACES** | US census tracts | `emburdendata` |

## Why so many sources?

Household energy burden is not a single-dataset object. Estimating it
requires:

- **Household expenditure surveys** to anchor the sector shares (GCD,
  Eurostat HBS)
- **Spatial density rasters** to allocate the surveys to cells (WorldPop,
  RWI)
- **Utility tariff schedules** to convert dollars into kWh (URDB)
- **Degree-day climatology** to compute physics-required demand (WB CCKP)
- **Grid generation mix** to attribute CO~2~ per kWh (Ember) — and,
  since Round 20, to attribute *transformity* (sej/J) per kWh through
  Odum's emergy framework
- **Access + affordability + QoS surveys** (WB electricity access,
  WHO clean-fuel, ESMAP MTF tiers) to complete the burden picture

Each source has its own vintage, coverage, and gaps; the pipeline
fills gaps with kNN imputation and documents the source-tier at every
cell.

## Reproducibility guarantees

- Every downloader script prefers open, direct-download APIs over
  commercial data
- Fallback chains ensure graceful degradation (e.g. EIA International
  falls back to OWID Energy if API key absent)
- All downloads write to a consistent local cache
  (`~/.cache/emburdendata/`) via `rappdirs`
- Cache files are content-addressed (renaming triggers re-download)
- Full pull scripts + cache locations are documented in
  [`docs/references.bib`](https://github.com/ericscheier/emburdensynth/blob/global/docs/references.bib)
  (19 dataset entries, auto-generated)

## Three pulls we could not fully automate

- **Yale Environmental Performance Index (EPI)** — no direct-download
  URL published; requires a web form. Not blocking.
- **EM-DAT (CRED disaster database)** — requires free CRED registration
  before bulk XLSX download. See
  [manual setup guide](https://github.com/ericscheier/emburdensynth/blob/global/docs/emdat_manual_setup.md).
- **ESMAP MTF tier surveys** — click-through XLSX from the WB Microdata
  Library; the manifest (`r if (is.na(n_esmap_covered)) "?" else n_esmap_covered` covered
  countries) is auto-cached but tier-share workbooks require a manual
  download per country. See
  [manual setup guide](https://github.com/ericscheier/emburdensynth/blob/global/docs/esmap_mtf_manual_setup.md).

Everything else is fully scripted.
